title: A novel oxime-derived 3d–4f single-molecule magnet exhibiting two single-ion magnetic relaxations

material_class.structural_family: butterfly-shaped {Dy4(μ3-OH)2} core with peripheral square-planar Ni(II) ions

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (41.2 mg, 0.1 mmol), Ni(ClO4)2·6H2O (35.4 mg, 0.1 mmol), Hpzaox (82.3 mg, 0.2 mmol) and triethylamine (121.4 mg, 1.2 mmol) in mixed CH3CN–CH3OH (v:v = 1:1, 10 mL) was sealed in a Parr Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel (23.0 mL) and heated at 70 °C for 12 h under autogenous pressure. After cooling to room temperature at 1.2 °C h−1, red block-shaped crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were obtained directly, washed with cold methanol and dried in air.
synthesis.temperature: 70 °C (solvothermal); cooled at 1.2 °C h−1 to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal reaction in a Parr Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel (23.0 mL) under autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: red block-shaped crystals obtained directly after cooling; washed with cold methanol and dried in air

properties.summary: Magnetically isolated {Dy4Ni6} cluster with a paramagnetic butterfly {Dy4(μ3-OH)2} core and diamagnetic square-planar Ni(II). Weak intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling is indicated by a low-T χMT upturn. Field-induced SMM behaviour with two thermally activated single-ion relaxations is observed under 1.0 kOe dc field; no hysteresis at 2.0 or 4.0 K.

measurements.conditions: Hdc = 1000 Oe, Hac = 3.5 Oe; Arrhenius fit, τ0 = 7.8 × 10−8 s
